contexts.text: Long arched courts, sometimes doubled, where they walk.
In the Prophets, everything is expressed in a twofold manner, especially in Isaiah...
Life is twofold, infernal and heavenly.
Their coats, etc., were not to be twofold, but single .
A half, and the double of a number, have a like signification.
The number five has a twofold signification...
Double silver () = successively another. Explained.
To be double () = to be conjoined. AC 8489.
He shall restore double () = restitution to the full. AC 9152. AC 9161.

Thou shalt double the sixth curtain over against the faces of the Tent () = the communication of all things of that Heaven with the extremes there, and influx thence into the ultimate Heaven. Explained.
There was a twofold court about the temple...

The square shall be doubled () = just and perfect. Square = just; and the reason it = perfect, is that it was doubled; for doubled involves all things of good and all things of truth; that which is on the right hand, involves good from which is truth; and that which is on the left hand, truth from good; thus, also, a perfect conjunction of both.
In the natural world, man has a twofold speech, because he has a twofold thought, exterior and interior... But in the Spiritual World, man has not a twofold speech, but a single one...

Double to her double according to her works; in the cup which she hath mixed mix to her double ()... = that the evils by which they have seduced and destroyed others will return upon them according to their quantity and quality... and that the falsities will return in like manner. AE 1115.
I perceive that in the world you have been twofold, one thing in internals and another in externals...
Duplicate adultery...
They are wiser than those who are twofold.
That there is twofoldness and threefoldness in every created thing...
Hypocrites possess a twofold mind...
The will of man is twofold, interior and exterior.
So he becomes a twofold man; a sheep in externals, and a wolf in internals.
(Modern) imputation is twofold... TCR 629.
One twofoldness is extended and undivided, and the other is restricted and separated; the latter is duplicity, but the former unity.
That man possesses a twofold memory...
In the duplicatures [folds] of the peritoneum. SE 995.
Man thus appears twofold...
Goods and truths are from a twofold origin...
That double is said of retribution and of reward. Illustrated.
That she has received double for all her sins = that they have endured much in temptation.
Redemption. 3. 2. In proportion as the man of the Church becomes external, he becomes twofold, that is, evil in internals, and appearing good in externals.
